title: Sort-analysis declared input corpus
purpose: The declared input material for the sort_analysis_v1 reference scenario. The review phase declares `inputs: [input-corpus:sort_analysis_v1]`; the composition root stores exactly these bytes under that artifact id, and the run chain registers the object as a non-model source whose digest is recomputable from this file (GOAL-010 EC-02).
scope: This scenario is the M7 reliable vertical slice: integration correctness, not research difficulty.
Phase 1 analyses an input algorithm repository; phase 2 independently reviews phase 1's report.
An upstream phase's artifact is another agent's output -- still model self-report -- so it is deliberately NOT the source registered for coverage.

documents.title: Subject of the analysis
documents.text: A small sorting implementation whose complexity and edge cases are the analysis subject. The review phase is grounded in this same input material rather than in the analysis it is reviewing.

documents.title: Why the input is the registered source
documents.text: Coverage must be satisfied by an object the evaluated agent did not produce. The analysed subject qualifies; the analysis and the review do not.
